# Meson cross-file template: Android arm64-v8a.
# Processed by build-scripts/build.sh via sed:
#   s|TOOLCHAIN|<path to NDK toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/<host>>|g
#   s|API|<minSdk API level, e.g. 24>|g
# Do NOT edit a generated copy -- edit this template.
#
# NOTE: NDK ships no llvm-pkg-config, so no pkgconfig entry here.
# build.sh sets PKG_CONFIG_LIBDIR=/nonexistent so host pkg-config
# resolves nothing and meson falls back to rizin's bundled wraps.

[binaries]
c = 'TOOLCHAIN/bin/aarch64-linux-androidAPI-clang'
cpp = 'TOOLCHAIN/bin/aarch64-linux-androidAPI-clang++'
ar = 'TOOLCHAIN/bin/llvm-ar'
ranlib = 'TOOLCHAIN/bin/llvm-ranlib'
strip = 'TOOLCHAIN/bin/llvm-strip'

[built-in options]
c_args = ['-fPIC', '-O2']
cpp_args = ['-fPIC', '-O2']

[host_machine]
system = 'android'
cpu_family = 'aarch64'
cpu = 'arm64-v8a'
endian = 'little'
